notes: I changed the model from predicting nothing to `f(x) ≈ 16.8·|x| − 0.25`, based on E1: the outputs scale linearly with |x| at slope ~16.8 (128→2150, 64→1075, 32→537), with a small negative offset (~−0.25) matching f(0)=−0.256. Residuals at small x are within the apparent noise band (~±1.5), so I treat them as noise rather than a separate mechanism.
